text:
ryan: starting attention kernel profiling sweep across H100/A100/L40S. seq lens: [64,256,1024,2048], bsz: [1,8,32]. tested variants: flash-v1, flash-v2-fused, paged, hybrid-tiling. nvprof/nsys traces saved to gs://redwood-perf/attn-sweeps/1824321000

kevin: nice. did you include KV-cache hot path? that can flip perf at long seqs.

ryan: yes — two modes: cold (empty KV) and warm (cached prefixes ~512 tokens). warm improves throughput but increases kernel memory pressure on H100 for paged-attn.

anna: top-level numbers? high-level summary plz :eyes:

ryan: summary:
- H100: fused (flash-v2-fused) wins for seq<=512 and bsz>=8. 1.3x vs paged.
- A100: paged-attn is competitive for seq>=1024 due to lower scratch allocs.
- L40S: flash-v1 has best latency for small batches, but memory constraints cause spill at seq=2048.

priya: any regressions vs main@176? we saw a perf cliff last week.

ryan: repro'd a regression on H100 for flash-v2-fused when seq~1024 and bsz=32 — tail latency up ~22% vs main@176. Traces point to kernel launch serialization in the fused path.

perf-bot: automated diff: 22% tail latency regression (H100, seq=1024, bsz=32) — trace ids: trace_1824321000_1

kevin: can you paste the nsys flame snippet of the fused kernel region?

ryan: sure:
```
nsys profile --sample=cpu --output=trace_1824321000
# snippet:
GPU Activity: fused_attn_kernel <<<grid>>> 12.4ms -> 18.9ms (serialization stalls between waves)
Memory: increased two temporary buffers x2 at launch
```

anna: hypothesis: kernel config picks block size that causes register spilling with seq=1024. maybe autotune selected wrong tile when batch dims high.

priya: suggest adding selection rule: if seq>=768 and bsz>=16 on H100, prefer paged or hybrid-tiling. try limiting fused tile width.

ryan: tried quick patch forcing hybrid-tiling for that config — tail latency back to baseline in local runs. I'll push a canary with fallback policy.

infra-bot: canary deployment queued — route=canary-5% for model:rw_example/serve123

kevin: also saw weird KV-cache eviction on L40S at seq=2048 causing extra memcpy -> latency spike. add memcopy accounting to profiler.

ryan: added memcopy samples, will re-run tomorrow across regions. Uploading raw logs to gs://redwood-perf/attn-sweeps/1824321000/raw/

anna: thanks. next steps: (1) run canary across H100 fleet, (2) add kernel-selection rule, (3) instrument memcpy in KV path. I'll schedule a quick sync after initial canary metrics.

priya: ping me when canary done, I'll prepare rollback criteria and perf-tests for CI.

ryan: noted. cc @anna @kevin

kevin: :thumbsup:
